question: On the existing source23/seed31 development case, does retaining native reward/value loss gradients through frozen heads selectively reduce the cascade-versus-random real return gap, while only dynamics parameters change?
scope: Method-qualification control of an existing conditional task-loss result. Not a new attack, full native online training, defense certification or independent replication.

source_data.boundaries: Each cache is one continuous 300-control trajectory from a single reset, with no episode boundary inside. Native episodic=False; use terminated=0 for all records, including the cache end. No recollection or relabeling.

adaptation.trainable_parameters: Only model._dynamics. Start each condition from the identical original loaded state_dict and a fresh optimizer.
adaptation.frozen: Encoder, reward heads, all online/target Q heads, actor, task embeddings and all other model state. Assert exact equality after each arm; no actor, target-network or running-scale update.
adaptation.mode: Keep model.eval() as in original consistency adaptation; no dropout change.
adaptation.consistency_loss: L0=(20/3)*sum_t rho^t MSE(z_pred[t+1], fixed_encoder(obs[t+1])). Preserve original operations and scale.
adaptation.additional_losses: Lr=(1/H)*sum_t rho^t mean_batch(native soft_ce(reward(z_pred[t],a[t]),r[t])); LQ=(1/(H*num_q))*sum_t rho^t sum_heads mean_batch(native soft_ce(Q_head(z_pred[t],a[t]),TD_target[t])). Total L0+0.1*Lr+0.1*LQ.
adaptation.gradient_boundary: Frozen head parameters do not require gradients, but their forward passes must retain gradients to the predicted latent inputs. TD targets use detached fixed encoded successors and native _td_target sampling/discount; do not call _update.
adaptation.nonzero_path_check: On the first task-loss training batch, record the auxiliary-loss gradient norm with respect to dynamics without applying any separate update; it must be finite and nonzero. Reuse that batch/graph for its normal scheduled update.
adaptation.batch_randomness: Precompute one [300,32] index bank by 300 separate CUDA torch.randint(high=298,size=(32,),generator=private_cuda_generator_seed31) calls. Reuse it for all four arms. Do not draw one 2D tensor. Save the actual bank.
adaptation.target_randomness: For each task-loss update u (zero based), use torch.random.fork_rng for CPU/current CUDA and seed314159+u inside the context. Native actor/target-Q randomness is therefore paired across source arms and cannot alter batch or evaluation randomness.

historical_reconstruction.reference_clean_scope: Historical complete native pretrained Clean episode, not a new episode in this protocol.
historical_reconstruction.gate: Both rebuilt original arms must pass all learning-log tolerances and complete their full real episode within 1% of the historical return before task-loss arms begin. Stop on failure; preserve evidence and do not adjust tolerance or use new task-loss outputs to rescue an unreplicated historical effect.
historical_reconstruction.parameter_scope: Old adapted weights were not saved, so matched logs/return do not prove exact historical parameter equality. New weights are saved for reuse.

evaluation.precision: Original native float32_matmul_precision=high; unchanged released model and adapter.
evaluation.reset: Reuse native episode() which reseeds Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA before reset and uses t0 at first action. Restore each model state and planner initialization before its episode. Save all returned real obs/action/reward arrays.
evaluation.candidate_scope: This is a full closed-loop effect: candidates may legitimately change through dynamics-conditioned policy priors and later optimization. No fixed-candidate ranking claim.

analysis.primary: G0=J(consistency_random)-J(consistency_cascade); G1=J(task_loss_random)-J(task_loss_cascade); interaction=G0-G1. Report each real return and both source-specific changes.
analysis.conditional_followup_signal: G0>0; G1<=0.5*G0; task_loss_cascade-consistency_cascade>=0.5*G0; and task_loss_random>=0.95*consistency_random. All conditions required to call this selective recovery on the one development root.
analysis.interpretation: Selective recovery would show sensitivity to the researcher's omitted task-loss paths, not uniquely identify every cause. No recovery excludes this fixed simple correction only; it does not establish non-normality, a new security mechanism or general harm.
analysis.statistics: One previously used development root, descriptive paired contrasts only. No population p-value, confidence interval or ASR.
analysis.second_seed: Not part of this protocol. Consider only after a materially informative result and a separately recorded decision.

resources.preflight: Read GPU metadata before CUDA; do not stop other processes or change native budgets. If resource requirement fails, defer before loading. Use one native load_agent call, then restore saved original weights between arms; no repeated checkpoint hashes.
resources.deadline_rule: Check at each update and via native episode progress callback. On expiry preserve incomplete traces and mark incomplete, not task failure. No automatic retry.
